# Pinned configured glass discovery

The four JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`.

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes

`manifest.json` gives each source path relative to that directory and SHA-256.
Native adaptations are the `recipes` event predicate and the bottle criterion's
legacy tag syntax; emission shares the existing recipe's config gate.
